system.description:
Favoured weapon: Club

Granted power: +1 AC while standing on natural stone or earth. On your first hit each round, the ground within 20ft of you becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until your next turn.

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Grumbar in the World of Arneyan wiki.
